files.purpose: Implements the Node-API 8 Windows Job Object owner, suspended process launch, bounded output polling and native cleanup interface.
files.ownership: The real Node/Electron utility owns the non-inheritable kill-on-close job; children share native job identity and own their process/thread/pipe handles.

consumers.evidence: The build target selects this source with N-API 8, C++17, Windows 10 and copied-buffer constraints; non-Windows builds are disabled.
The public loader requires actual win32 x64/arm64, N-API 8 and matching nativeInfo before returning the native exports.
The declared job/child/output APIs match the bounded native ownership interface.
The Engine adapter polls exit separately from pipe EOF and pauses byte reads for pending output sinks.
The host forwards ownership operations, closes job before children and refuses a direct-child fallback.
The orchestrator records assigned ownership before resume and preserves bounded cleanup uncertainty.
Actual win32 command execution constructs WindowsJobCommandBackend and records lock/observer admission.
The reviewed registration block installs the command tool in the Engine catalogue and exposes the actual process backend capability.
Electron packaging rebuilds this addon for the pinned Electron/architecture and hashes the real binary.
The native package remains ASAR-unpacked at its package-relative path.

observations: Handle move/close/destructor ownership is explicit (40-63); environment teardown and finalizers have their own best-effort native cleanup paths (138-164). Explicit close errors are distinct from teardown best effort.
Unicode inputs reject NUL; environment names are case-insensitively unique and sorted; output pipes restrict inherited handles (228-309).
Spawn attaches PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST before CREATE_SUSPENDED creation (414-473); assign checks ownership and resume requires the assigned suspended identity (476-515).
ReadPipe and readOutput cap each stream at 65536 bytes, preserve independent EOF/exit status and copy JS buffers (331-390).
activeProcessCount queries actual Job accounting; CreateJob installs KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE; nativeInfo and NAPI_MODULE register the exported interface (528-623).
files.conclusion: Full native source plus concrete build/loader/Engine/packaging consumers were reviewed. No native execution repair or safe deletion/extraction judgment is established.
limits: No C++ parser/compiler, addon load, Windows process/crash/handle experiment or native/GUI acceptance was executed.
Workflow qualification is Windows x64 Node 24/26; arm64, other Windows versions and actual packaged Electron evidence remain separate runtime limits.
The backend runs with host-user file/network authority; Job ownership is not a file/network sandbox.
